normie.tagline: Five animal parts. Name every one.
normie.quip: Three hearts, blue blood, ears on its legs. Nature is unwell.
normie.helpQuip: Nature is weird. That’s the whole point.
help: Each day brings five rounds: name the highlighted part of an animal, or pick the weird-but-true body fact.
Four options per round. One tap, no take-backs.
Every answer comes with a quick explanation and usually a strange fact.
Score 3 or more out of 5 to keep your streak alive.
Diagrams are simple sketches: octopus, owl, giraffe, cat, elephant, shark, frog, sea star, bee and a horse’s hoof.
Difficulty rises through the week: Easy Mon-Tue, Medium Wed-Thu, Hard Fri-Sat, Genius Sun. A new set arrives at midnight, Sydney time.

labelosis: Anatomegaly in Normie mode is a daily animal anatomy puzzle. Each day brings five rounds: name the highlighted part of an octopus, owl, giraffe, cat, shark and friends, or pick the weird-but-true body fact. Four options per round, and every answer comes with a short explanation.
No. Normie scores and streaks are kept separately.
Yes. Every fact is checked, and the diagrams are original, simplified sketches. Animals vary, and nature loves an exception.
